caption: The drawing depicts a quilt composed of a grid of 6 rows and 6 columns, making 36 square blocks in total. Each block contains a circular starburst or pinwheel pattern with pointed rays radiating from the center, in alternating shades of pink, red, and white. The circles are set inside blocks with alternating backgrounds of light pink and darker red. The blocks are separated by sashing bands filled with a pale blue color arranged in a grid pattern, giving the quilt a checkerboard appearance. A border of the same pale blue surrounds the central grid, and the entire quilt is edged with a thin green border. The drawing is placed on a beige or light tan background with no additional elements or decorative motifs outside the quilt design itself.
title: Quilt
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
